findingClass: for either slot, the newest 3 consecutive lines in /var/log/ipodhan-scraper-wake-<slot>.log are all wake-skipped -- a stale cycle lock (TTL 2h05m) after a SIGKILL, OOM or reboot makes every wake print wake-skipped for up to 2h05m with nothing raising an alert; a run of skips spanning more than one 30min wake interval is the same visible shape whatever the underlying cause (a stale lock, a hung run, or anything else holding it)
failThreshold: for either slot, the newest 3 wake log lines are all wake-skipped
unverifiableWhen: the wake log files are not reachable on this host (expected on a dev machine or CI; runs for real on the box via cron)
